公司簡介
CORPORATE PROFILE

華潤建材科技控股有限公司（前稱華潤水泥控股有限公司）於二零零三年三月十三日根據開曼群島公司法在開曼群
島註冊成立為一家獲豁免的有限公司，並為華潤集團所有水泥及混凝土業務的控股公司。


本公司曾於二零零三年七月二十九日以介紹形式在香港聯合交易所有限公司主板上市。於二零零六年，本公司被
華潤（集團）有限公司私有化成為順創投資有限公司（現稱華潤集團（水泥）有限公司）的全資附屬公司，並於二零零
六年七月二十六日撤銷其股份在聯交所的上市地位。


本公司於二零零九年十月六日以全球發售形式重新於聯交所主板上市。於二零二三年十一月三日，本公司由華潤
水泥控股有限公司更名為華潤建材科技控股有限公司。於本報告日期，本公司已發行股份總數為 6,982,937,817 股，
其中華潤集團持有約 68.72% 的本公司已發行股份。


China Resources Building Materials Technology Holdings Limited (formerly known as China Resources Cement
Holdings Limited) was incorporated on 13 March 2003 in the Cayman Islands as an exempted company with limited
liability under the Companies Law of the Cayman Islands and is the holding company of all the cement and concrete
operations of China Resources Group.


The Company was listed on the main board of The Stock Exchange of Hong Kong Limited on 29 July 2003 by way of
introduction. In 2006, the Company was privatized as a wholly-owned subsidiary of Smooth Concept Investments
Limited (currently known as CRH (Cement) Limited) by China Resources (Holdings) Company Limited and the listing
of the Company’s shares on the Stock Exchange was withdrawn on 26 July 2006.


The Company was re-listed on the main board of the Stock Exchange on 6 October 2009 by way of a global offering.
On 3 November 2023, the Company changed its name from China Resources Cement Holdings Limited to China
Resources Building Materials Technology Holdings Limited. As at the date of this report, the total number of issued
shares of the Company was 6,982,937,817 shares, of which China Resources Group is holding approximately 68.72%
of the issued shares of the Company.

     過 完 善 的 水 路、鐵 路 及 公 路 物 流 網 絡，產 品                    of cement, clinker and concrete. Products are mainly sold in
     主 要 在 廣 東、廣 西、福 建、海 南、雲 南、貴                          Guangdong, Guangxi, Fujian, Hainan, Yunnan, Guizhou, Shanxi and
     州、山 西 及 湖 南 銷 售。本 集 團 產 品 主 要 用 於                    Hunan through well-established waterway, railway and road

二零二三年，中國房地產市場仍為深度調整                     In 2023, it was still a year of profound adjustment for China’s real
的 一 年。二 零 二 三 年 七 月，中 央 政 治 局 會 議       estate market. In July 2023, the Central Committee’s Political
定調「行業供需關係發生重大轉變」，為後續                    Bureau meeting set the tone that “the supply and demand
政策鬆綁打開空間，此後中央多個部門明確                     relationship in the industry had undergone material changes”,

                 Bureau in April 1997. He worked in the Hong Kong Government as
                 a Principal Official from July 1997 to June 2007. Senior positions
                 held by Mr. IP in the past include Commissioner of Insurance,
                 Commissioner for Labour, Secretary for Economic Services and
                 Secretary for Financial Services. Mr. IP took up the position of
                 Secretary for Economic Development and Labour in July 2002. His
                 portfolio in respect of economic development covered air and sea
                 transport, logistics development, tourism, energy, postal services,
                 meteorological services, competition and consumer protection. He
                 was also responsible for labour policies including matters relating
                 to employment services, labour relations and employees rights.


                 In his capacity as Secretary for Economic Development and Labour,
                 Mr. IP was a member of the Hong Kong Airport Authority Board,
                 the Mandatory Provident Fund Authority Board, the Hong Kong
                 International Theme Parks Company Board as well as the Chairman
                 of the Logistics Development Council, Port Development Board,
                 Maritime Industry Council and Aviation Development Advisory
                 Committee. Mr. IP retired from the Hong Kong Government in July

                 May 2011, Luk Fook Holdings (International) Limited since October

本集團的風險管治架構建基於「三道防線」模                The Group’s risk management structure is based on the “three lines
式，明 確 風 險 管 理 分 工 與 管 理 職 責。第 一 道   of defense” model, which clarifies the roles and responsibilities of
防線由各級業務單位和職能部室組成，負責                 management, business units and functional departments on risk
日 常 風 險 管 理，參 與 評 估 本 集 團 的 風 險，制   management. The first line of defense consists of business units
定應對措施及監控程序；第二道防線由風險                 and functional departments at all levels, responsible for daily risk
管理職能部室組成，負責風險管理的組織、                 management, including participation in risk assessment of the
推動和協調工作，並監察本集團的主要及潛                 Group, development of risk mitigation measures and monitoring
在風險；第三道防線由內部控制及內部審計                 procedures; the second line of defense consists of risk
職能部室組成，負責風險管理的監督和檢查，                management functional department, responsible for organizing,
開展內部風險評價及監督。                        promoting and coordinating the risk management, and monitoring
                                    the Group’s major and potential risks; the third line of defense
                                    consists of functional departments of internal control and internal
                                    audit, responsible for risk management supervision and inspection,
                                    internal assurance activities, assessment of internal risk
                                    management and monitoring.

     曼群島註冊成立為一家獲豁免有限公                     Law (2002 Revision) of the Cayman Islands on 13 March 2003
     司，其股份於二零零九年十月六日在香                    and its shares were listed on The Stock Exchange of Hong
     港聯合交易所有限公司上市。本公司的                    Kong Limited on 6 October 2009. Its immediate holding
     直接控股公司是在英屬處女群島註冊成                    company is CRH (Cement) Limited, a company incorporated
     立的華潤集團（水泥）有限公司。本公司                   in the British Virgin Islands. Its ultimate holding company is
     的最終控股公司是於中國內地成立的中                    China Resources Company Limited, a company established in
     國華潤有限公司。                             the Chinese Mainland.


     本公司為一間投資控股公司，而其附屬                    The Company is an investment holding company and its
     公司（於本報告內與本公司統稱為「本集                   subsidiaries (together with the Company hereinafter

2.   呈列貨幣之變動                         2.   CHANGE OF PRESENTATION CURRENCY
     本 公 司 的 功 能 貨 幣 為 人 民 幣（「人 民         The Company’s functional currency is Renminbi (“RMB”). The
     幣」）。過往財政年度綜合財務報表的呈                   presentation currency of the consolidated financial statements
     列貨幣為港元（「港元」）。                        in the prior financial year was Hong Kong dollars (“HK$”).


     由於本集團主要於中國內地經營其業                     Since the Group mainly operates its business in the Chinese
     務，且本集團大部分資產及負債以人民                    Mainland and most of the assets and liabilities of the Group
     幣計值，故本公司董事認為將人民幣用                    are denominated in RMB, the directors of the Company
     作本集團的呈列貨幣更合適，及以人民                    consider that it is more appropriate to use RMB as the
     幣呈列財務報表可為管理層提供更多相                    presentation currency of the Group and the presentation of
     關資料以控制及監控本集團的表現及財                    financial statements in RMB can provide more relevant
     務狀況。因此，由二零二三年一月一日                    information for management to control and monitor the
     起，本集團將編製財務報表的呈列貨幣                    performance and financial position of the Group. Accordingly,
     由 港 元 改 為 人 民 幣。比 較 數 字 經 已 重        the Group has changed its presentation currency for the
     列，以與本年度以人民幣呈列保持一致。                   preparation of the financial statements from HK$ to RMB
                                          starting from 1 January 2023. The comparative figures have
                                          been restated to conform with the current year’s presentation

               貸 虧 損 計 提 預 期 信 貸 虧 損 撥 備。                               For those credit exposures for which there has been a

               加 的 信 貸 敞 口 而 言，須 就 預 期 於                                a loss allowance is required for credit losses expected

               計 提 虧 損 撥 備，不 論 違 約 的 時 間                                the timing of the default (a lifetime ECL).
               （全期預期信貸虧損）。

  37. 資本風險管理                                           37. CAPITAL RISK MANAGEMENT
        本集團管理其資本，以確保本集團的實                                    The Group manages its capital to ensure that entities in the
        體將可以持續經營，並透過優化債務及                                    Group will be able to continue as a going concern while
        權益結餘為持份者帶來最大回報。於兩                                    maximising the return to stakeholders through the
        個年度，本集團的整體策略維持不變。                                    optimization of the debt and equity balance. The Group’s
                                                             overall strategy remains unchanged for both years.


        本集團的資本架構包括債務（其中包括                                    The capital structure of the Group consists of debts, which
        附註 33 的來自非控股股東的貸款、附註                                 includes loans from non-controlling shareholders in Note 33,
        34 的銀行貸款）及本公司擁有人應佔權                                  bank loans in Note 34 and equity attributable to owners of
        益（包括已發行股本及儲備）。                                       the Company, comprising issued share capital and reserves.


        本公司管理層每半年審核一次資本架                                     The management of the Company reviews the capital
        構。作為此審核的一部分，管理層會考                                    structure on a semi-annual basis. As part of this review,
        慮資本成本及與各類別資本相關的風                                     management considers the cost of capital and the risks
